description: Request-level investigation across audit logs, application logs, and Tempo traces. Select one environment and one trace for transaction evidence.

links.title: App Capacity
links.tooltip: GitHub App pool capacity and quota

panels.title: Log Rate by Level
panels.description: Log rate by severity, resolved from the Loki index rather than by parsing. Lines with an empty level are the plain-text startup and config failures that slog never formatted - see Startup & Crash Output.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | trace_id!="" | trace_id="$trace_id" [$__range]))

sum by (result) (count_over_time({app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", log_channel="audit"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | app_extracted=~"$app" | result=~"$result" | identity=~"$identity" | label_format event_category=`{{ if eq .result "success" }}success{{ else if or (eq .result "policy_denied") (eq .result "org_policy_denied") (eq .result "trust_policy_invalid") (eq .result "policy_not_found") }}policy{{ else if or (eq .result "oidc_invalid") (eq .result "jti_replay") }}auth{{ else if or (eq .result "github_error") (eq .result "bundle_stale") (eq .result "bundle_unavailable") }}upstream{{ else }}infra{{ end }}` | event_category=~"$event_category" | trace_id!="" | trace_id="$trace_id" [$__range]))

max(max_over_time({app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", log_channel="audit"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | app_extracted=~"$app" | result=~"$result" | identity=~"$identity" | label_format event_category=`{{ if eq .result "success" }}success{{ else if or (eq .result "policy_denied") (eq .result "org_policy_denied") (eq .result "trust_policy_invalid") (eq .result "policy_not_found") }}policy{{ else if or (eq .result "oidc_invalid") (eq .result "jti_replay") }}auth{{ else if or (eq .result "github_error") (eq .result "bundle_stale") (eq .result "bundle_unavailable") }}upstream{{ else }}infra{{ end }}` | event_category=~"$event_category" | trace_id!="" | trace_id="$trace_id" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Selected Trace Summary
panels.description: Exact trace ID only. With no ID, this panel intentionally shows SELECT TRACE ID rather than aggregating the whole dashboard range.

panels.title: Trace Waterfall (expand after setting a Trace ID)
Trace View - $trace_id
panels.description: One exact trace waterfall. The same ID appears in response headers and audit/log events. The reviewed application currently emits one server span per exchange; stage child spans are future telemetry work.

Collapsed by default on purpose: the Tempo traces panel requires a single trace ID and renders a query error when the Trace ID variable is empty. A collapsed row does not run its queries until expanded, so the default view stays clean. Paste an ID above, then expand.

panels.title: Transaction Timeline (chronological, all channels)
panels.description: Every log line for the exact selected Trace ID, oldest first. With no ID, no transaction logs are queried. Tempo is configured for this dashboard.

targets.expr: {app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", log_channel!="audit", level=~"$level"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | msg!="access" | trace_id=~".*$trace_id.*"

panels.title: Application Logs
panels.description: Non-audit, non-access lines: bundle reloads, TUF refresh, startup and background work.

targets.expr: {app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", log_channel!="audit", level=~"$level"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | msg="access" | trace_id=~".*$trace_id.*"

panels.title: Access Logs (HTTP)
panels.description: HTTP request log lines (msg="access"). These carry no log_channel label, so they are selected by message, not by channel.

targets.expr: {app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", log_channel="audit", level=~"$level"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | app_extracted=~"$app" | result=~"$result" | identity=~"$identity" | label_format event_category=`{{ if eq .result "success" }}success{{ else if or (eq .result "policy_denied") (eq .result "org_policy_denied") (eq .result "trust_policy_invalid") (eq .result "policy_not_found") }}policy{{ else if or (eq .result "oidc_invalid") (eq .result "jti_replay") }}auth{{ else if or (eq .result "github_error") (eq .result "bundle_stale") (eq .result "bundle_unavailable") }}upstream{{ else }}infra{{ end }}` | event_category=~"$event_category" | trace_id=~".*$trace_id.*"

panels.title: Audit Logs
panels.description: Token-exchange audit trail. app_extracted is the GitHub App parsed from the JSON body; Loki renames it because "app" is already a stream label (the Kubernetes workload).

panels.title: Errors & Warnings (all channels)
panels.description: Errors and warnings across every channel. The empty alternative in level=~"(ERROR|WARN|)" admits the plain-text startup failures that carry no level label, and __error__="" is deliberately absent so a line that is not JSON is still shown. github-sts emits only uppercase levels, so no lowercase alternatives are needed.

panels.title: Startup & Crash Output (unparsed)
panels.description: Everything the JSON pipeline cannot see. Config validation and startup failures are written by Go's default log package before slog is configured, so they are plain text on stderr with no level label and no trace_id.

panels.title: Unparsed Lines
panels.description: Plain-text lines with no level label over the dashboard range. Any non-zero value means a pod is failing before it can configure structured logging - almost always a crashloop.

panels.title: Startup / Config Failures (plain text, stderr)
panels.description: Raw, unparsed output. No | json and no level filter, because these lines have neither. This is where a CrashLoopBackOff shows its actual cause - one line per restart.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (error_reason) (rate({app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", log_channel="audit"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | app_extracted=~"$app" | result=~"$result" | identity=~"$identity" | label_format event_category=`{{ if eq .result "success" }}success{{ else if or (eq .result "policy_denied") (eq .result "org_policy_denied") (eq .result "trust_policy_invalid") (eq .result "policy_not_found") }}policy{{ else if or (eq .result "oidc_invalid") (eq .result "jti_replay") }}auth{{ else if or (eq .result "github_error") (eq .result "bundle_stale") (eq .result "bundle_unavailable") }}upstream{{ else }}infra{{ end }}` | event_category=~"$event_category" | error_reason!="" [$window])))

panels.title: Top Audit error_reason (rate/interval)
panels.description: Top 10 audit failure reasons. Rising series = systemic issue (policy denial pattern, OIDC misconfig, GitHub-side failure).

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (github_app) (rate(githubsts_token_exchanges_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$replica",github_app=~"$app",result=~"cache_error|github_error|bundle_stale|bundle_unavailable|bundle_evaluation_failed|unknown_error"}[$window])) or on(github_app) 0 * sum by (github_app) (rate(githubsts_token_exchanges_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$replica",github_app=~"$app"}[$window]))) / sum by (github_app) (rate(githubsts_token_exchanges_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$replica",github_app=~"$app"}[$window]))

panels.title: System Fault Rate by App (%)
panels.description: Broker/dependency fault outcomes divided by all attributed exchange attempts. Policy/authentication rejections are excluded.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (identity, result) (rate({app="github-sts", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", log_channel="audit"} |= "$search" | json | __error__="" | app_extracted=~"$app" | result=~"$result" | identity=~"$identity" | label_format event_category=`{{ if eq .result "success" }}success{{ else if or (eq .result "policy_denied") (eq .result "org_policy_denied") (eq .result "trust_policy_invalid") (eq .result "policy_not_found") }}policy{{ else if or (eq .result "oidc_invalid") (eq .result "jti_replay") }}auth{{ else if or (eq .result "github_error") (eq .result "bundle_stale") (eq .result "bundle_unavailable") }}upstream{{ else }}infra{{ end }}` | event_category=~"$event_category" | result!="success" [$window])))

panels.title: Top Identities on Non-Success Outcomes
panels.description: Grouped by identity: the audit slog emitter does not write remote_ip to stdout (only to the audit FILE sink), so a remote_ip breakdown is not derivable from container logs.

panels.title: Security Counter Anomaly z-score (6h baseline)
panels.description: Rolling z-score of key security counters vs their 6h baseline. |z| > 2 = unusual; |z| > 3 = strongly anomalous. Designed for live AI-agent triage without static thresholds.

panels.title: Audit Writer Activity
panels.description: Application writer activity and errors. events logged means processed by the writer; it does not prove file persistence or Loki ingestion.

panels.title: Successful Exchange Duration by App
panels.description: p50/p95/p99 of successful exchanges only. Review volume before interpreting sparse percentiles.

panels.title: Trace Explorer (Tempo)
panels.description: Find a trace when you do not already have an ID. Click a traceID to open it in the waterfall above.

panels.title: Recent Traces
panels.description: Most recent traces in the selected trace environment. Tempo lacks a Kubernetes namespace resource attribute in the reviewed deployment.

panels.title: Slow Traces (>250ms)
panels.description: Traces slower than 250 ms in the selected trace environment. This is a diagnostic threshold, not an agreed SLO.

panels.title: Server-Fault Trace Candidates (HTTP >=500)
panels.description: Recent server-error traces. Expected 4xx policy/authentication rejections remain available in audit outcomes.

list.name: tempo_datasource
list.label: Tempo
list.description: Tempo datasource backing the trace panels.
Tempo resource environment. Keep this aligned with the selected Namespace until deployment exports a namespace resource attribute.
list.label: Trace Environment
list.name: environment

list.label: Namespace
list.name: namespace
list.description: Deployment namespace. The default selects one environment so production and development telemetry are never silently aggregated.

list.label: Job
list.name: job
list.description: Prometheus scrape job discovered from github-sts metrics.

list.label: github-sts Replica
list.name: replica
list.description: github-sts pod as Prometheus sees it (IP:port). Metric panels only; use Pod for log panels.

list.label: App
list.name: app
list.description: Logical GitHub App. On log panels this matches app_extracted. Note: exchanges that fail before the app is resolved (oidc_invalid, jti_replay) carry an empty app, so picking a specific app hides them.

Physical GitHub App instance within a logical app pool, from the Prometheus label github_app_instance. Values are the instance's configured name, or its app_id when the name is omitted. Applies to metric panels only; Loki audit panels carry the same value as instance_extracted.
list.label: GitHub App Instance
list.name: app_instance

list.description: github-sts pod as Loki sees it. This is the log-side equivalent of the Replica variable.
list.label: Pod
list.name: pod

list.description: Log level, case-normalised in the query: the service writes INFO/WARN/ERROR and some dependencies write lower case.
list.label: Level
list.name: level

list.description: Groups the 13 audit ExchangeResult values into triage buckets. Audit panels only. Auth Failure covers exchanges rejected before the GitHub App is resolved.
list.label: Event Category
list.name: event_category
list.query: Success : success,Policy Denied : policy,Auth Failure : auth,Upstream Error : upstream,Infra Error : infra

list.description: Lookback window for every rate() and per-interval panel. Widen it to smooth low-traffic periods, narrow it to catch short spikes.
list.label: Rate Window
list.name: window

list.description: Case-sensitive substring applied to the raw log line before parsing. Leave empty to match everything.
list.label: Line contains
list.name: search

list.label: Trace ID
list.name: trace_id
list.description: Paste a 32-hex trace ID to pin one request across traces, metrics and logs. Empty means no filter. The value is substituted into Loki as a substring match, so a partial ID works too.

list.name: result
list.label: Result
list.description: Audit exchange result. Plain tokens with no regex metacharacters, so Grafana's multi-select interpolation is safe here.

list.name: identity
list.label: Identity
list.description: Regex on the audit identity field, e.g. ci or ^deploy. Leave as .* for all.
